name: aivideogenerator
description: Narrated explainer videos in the 3Blue1Brown style from an article or a document.

plugins.name: aivideogenerator
plugins.description: Two skills: article-to-video makes a video in the 3Blue1Brown style from an article, a paper, or notes, in the language that you select; omnivoice-voice installs the local speech engine omnivoice and prepares a voice cloned from your recordings.
